#  昊荒=Haohuang, 御兰=Yulan, 竺虎=Zhuhu, 莫尔=Moore, 秋兴=Qiuxing, 蓝柒=Lanqi, 溪月=Xiyue, 冰家=Ice Clan, 13斧=13 Axes.

column2: …You're the Na Family's ancestor! This… how is it possible? The Elder and Father both said you…

No need to be surprised. I am indeed the Na Family's ancestor, named Na Ying.
None of the Na Family's descendants today know that this wisp of my will
lies hidden within the Secret Realm.
Were it known, I fear this realm
would be turned upside down by that band of explorers.
What happened? What befell you back then, to leave you like this?

Heh, little girl, don't rush.
It's just a dull old tale.
Back then, to gather materials for a deal,
I took a reckless risk and ventured deep into the perilous Blood Demon Sea
to hunt powerful Wildbeasts.
In the Blood Demon Sea, I carelessly fell into a trap
and became the soul-servant of a Domain-Tier powerhouse.
That powerhouse… was likely near equal in strength to the Lord of Yangang City.

These powerhouses bind soul-servants
simply to obtain powerful "cannon fodder."
Back then, I had no way to escape at all.
Those soul-servants obey their master for life, with no freedom,
death looming over them at any moment.
Most, after enduring endless dangers day and night, died wretchedly!
To escape this fate, I chose to destroy my own soul!
—and transferred my consciousness to this single wisp of thought.
This wisp was originally stored within the Family Secret Realm
to relay messages to the family, but now it has come in handy.
Me… may I? If there's anything I can do to help you, Senior, please just say it.

Your fire-element insight has reached minor completion,
but there's still great room to grow.
A Domain-realm powerhouse
can spread open a 【Domain】 imbued with law-insight against foes;
I once saw that one cast it a few times.
Over several thousand years, I've formed my own understanding of this Domain.
Now, I'll pass my insight into such a Technique on to you. Listen carefully.
Yes, this junior obeys.

Na Ying extended a finger and touched it to Neko's brow.
At once, a vast flood of information poured into her mind,
immersing her for a time in all manner of profound insights.
After a moment, Neko opened her eyes,
excitement flickering in them.
She could feel just how much these insights would help her.
[Neko] Senior, thank you.
I now have a clear grasp of the road ahead.
[Na Ying] No need for thanks.
I think my inheritance is about done here.
Next, work hard to improve yourself.
When I awaken again, I hope to see you risen to a higher level.
Senior, you're… going to slumber?

Heh, a mere wisp of thought can't hold on for long.
When I'll wake next, there's no telling.
If you wish to test yourself——
go to the depths of this Barrier Lake.
There are "Spirits" naturally bred within the barrier
that have gained consciousness and wish to resist and break free.
For the realm's stability, I entrust this task to you.
Go on. I won't keep you.
Sister, this vast ruin… is this where Shenglü City once stood?

Yes. It's said that alien visitor
piloted a massive flying object,
a palace-class treasure called the "D9-tier Spaceship."
That treasure blasted the entire city into ruins,
inflicting heavy casualties on our Bloodfall Continent.
In the end——through the combined siege of several hundred city-lord-level powerhouses,
and even the intervention of one heaven-and-earth-spanning being,
the treasure was finally shot down!
…Several hundred city-lord-level! So powerhouses from a dozen-odd nearby fiefs had all gathered here?

At least more than half came.
But when the powerhouses stormed inside the "D9 Spaceship,"
they found the alien visitor wasn't in there at all.
We underestimated the alien visitor.
He had long since quietly released over a hundred small flying objects,
called "B9 Spaceships," to make his escape.
D9, B9. It feels like some kind of classification. What could it be…

Who knows.
True, these small flying objects are only treasure-grade in material,
but they're small and fast — for a while, no one could find their trail.
It was that great figure who acted personally:
within the range of his soul-detection, nothing could hide.
In the end, the powerhouses intercepted the treasure-ship he rode
just below the eighteenth cloud layer,
and destroyed every last spaceship.
Phew… what a rollercoaster. Our goal is to find those fallen "spaceships" and search for the treasures we need, right?

Exactly. The treasures within that main battle-ship
are, at this moment, being fought over by Skyhigh-Tier-and-above powerhouses.
Our target, however, is those small spaceships.
But——there's one more target,
Koko, right before your eyes.
The ruins of Shenglü City.
Shenglü City's… ruins?

Mm, that's right. Once-prosperous Shenglü City,
after turning to ruins, saw many of its residents die,
leaving much behind. The Head has ordered
the whole Na Family to split up and search,
and once we find useful valuables and treasures——
Wait, Sister, this way of doing things… isn't it wrong? Won't the people of this city be unable to rest in peace?

Koko, all your sister knows is that
so long as it helps the Na Family grow faster,
these things are worth it.
Right now, every faction big and small from the nearby cities is doing the same thing.
Winning more for ourselves isn't easy,
and there's no time to grieve for those refugees.
…I, I'll do as you say, Sister.
(If the same thing happened to Yangang City, would everyone… treat us this way too?)
…Are you thirsty? I'll go find you some water.

Thank you, girl, but there's no need.
Thanks to this calamity, the debt I owe the Lord's Manor is wiped clean.
In a bit, I'll head into the city too.
The fortunes of Sky-Tier and even Skyhigh-Tier folk
are left behind in there in no small amount.
Even just part of one powerhouse's estate
would be enough to keep me worry-free for the rest of my life, hahaha——
…Then, I'll leave you be.

(Come to think of it… after getting back to Yangang City, should I ask the Lord's Manor
to lend me 10B, 8B or so?)
If the same thing happened to Yangang City,
at least there'd be resources to start over.
Stop and steady your mind.
Barely out of the city and there's a pungent stench of blood… how awful.

Just this one alien visitor
caused so many powerhouses to fall.
I must stay clear-headed and not create needless slaughter.
Otherwise… I'll only stray further and further down this road.

[Haohuang] Yulan! You again.
My Shenghuang City people found this spaceship first.
Don't tell me your Lanling City intends to keep shamelessly fighting over it?
(A spaceship! News of a spaceship?)

[Yulan] My General Hao, what are you saying?
This time, it was your Shenghuang City forces who deliberately provoked us;
Lanling City merely acted in self-defense.
[Haohuang] Since you're so obtuse, I've no need to waste more words with you!
With your handful of people, hoping to break our Wildgate Grand Array
is nothing but wishful thinking!
Huh, they're already fighting? What a spectacular battle.

(Fierce Giant Sword effects)
(Fierce lightning-strike effects)

[Neko] Phew… even from this far away,
I can clearly feel the terrifying aftershocks of that energy.

But more than fear,
seeing these powerful, exquisite Techniques cast with my own eyes
is truly exciting.
It feels like—— some of the insights deep in my mind
have already become my own.

[Bright Moon Projection]
(This is an auto-reply)
What era is it — quit the old-fashioned rituals,
just offer up some Knife Coins as tribute.
In return, you can receive the Bright Moon's blessing…

Oh, and the more abundant your life force, the more the blessing costs,
so you'll have to pay extra.
Cultivators above Sky-Tier Rank 4, forget it —
this little statue can't hold too strong a power-projection.
(Check the current blessing and cost info)
Sister! Why are you here?

[Neko] …Sister? Poke poke.
Neko tilted her head.
Her sister didn't seem to react at all;
she was focused intently on a book in her hands.
[Neko] The spine reads… "Genetic Primal-Energy Application - The Art of the Ethereal"?
Sister seems immersed in this book,
as if on the verge of an epiphany. Better not disturb her…
Neko quietly kept watch to the side, and in the blink of an eye three shichen (six hours) passed.

[Nanami] I see, no wonder.
This book explains things in such detail — such a big gain in so short a time,
it's simply amazing!
She tossed the book aside,
then stood up and stretched,
looked over — and Neko was glaring at her with resentful eyes.
[Nanami/Neko] Waaaaah!!
What was that, Sister! Why'd you suddenly make that noise!

[Nanami] K-Koko, when did you get here?
I thought those sheet-metal monsters had come…
[Neko] Mm, about three shichen. No matter how I called, you didn't answer.
[Nanami] Ugh, it's all Sister's fault for worrying you. That cultivation book just now seemed to have a pull to it — I got absorbed without realizing.
But Sister, a 2e8 Ethereal value gets nullified the moment an enemy has 2e6 Agility, and the enemies here all have over 2e6 Agility…

[Nanami] Huh, Koko, what did you just say?
[Neko] From what I know of this game, as long as you don't learn Restraint, there's no harm.
[Nanami] …Is that how the settings work now?!
The two exchanged the gains of this spaceship trip,
along with what they'd seen and heard along the way.
[Nanami] Much of the intel I found came from the books on this shelf.
They seem to record plenty about the Alien Clans,
though sadly they don't mention a word of the more core content.
Sister, you're saying these puppets are called "technological creations" by the Alien Clans? And many of the ones along the way are "A9" and "B1" tier?

[Nanami] Yes. If the records on the shelf are true,
the three grades A, B, C correspond to Earth-, Sky-, and Skyhigh-Tier,
and the numbers after them map in turn to the sub-realms.
[Neko] So "A9" tier means Earth-Tier Rank 9?
But the ones I saw along the way, like that Blue-Skinned Monster…
they're probably equal to early Sky-Tier combat power.
[Nanami] We can only conclude… the Alien Clans' classification is stricter,
more than half a tier above the Bloodfall world.
Koko, you're so strong now.
Without the Laser Gun, the me of today
would have no way to deal with those technological creations.
It's not that impressive, hmph. So, Sister, what do we do now?

[Nanami] Since we've already come this far, of course we press on.
An alien visitor's spaceship… who knows how many years before you see one again.
Even setting aside all the possible precious treasures, I still want to try out my newly-learned insight.
[Neko] That one's really useless…
Sister, why not take a Bright Moon blessing during the new moon,
then drink this Wind Return Potion?
Guaranteed to more than double your damage!
With your health, it only takes sixteen Large Coins to accept the blessing!

[Nanami] Eh… never mind. We're already inside the spaceship;
we can't very well run all the way back out to find a statue…

No one could have imagined
that the radiation from the alien visitor's crashed spaceship
could mutate so many Wildbeasts.
Perhaps this was the outsider's final revenge…
These Wildbeasts became stronger and more savage than before.
Great numbers of Sky-Tier and even Skyhigh-Tier Wildbeasts were born, and the Beast Tide arose.
Father, have you experienced a Beast Tide before? What was it like?

[Nabu] As the name implies…
countless maddened Wildbeasts storm human towns,
and many weak commoners lose their homes and are left destitute.
[Neko] …How pitiful…
[Nabu] Koko, this time the Lord's Manor has offered rich rewards,
gained by several great fiefs from the alien visitor.
Just hunt Wildbeasts and bring back proof to claim the reward.
Father, has Sister already set out with the family's first team?

All right, it's about time. The Na Family's next team has moved out,
so gather yourself and set off.
With the super-powerhouses of Yangang City's main force clearing the way,
there's no need to worry about running into a roaming Domain-Tier or Skyhigh-Tier beast king.
Use Wildbeast Tokens to exchange for items (including converters)
Convert the Heart of the Barrier Lake (requires the Heart of the Barrier Lake to be in the equipment slot)
Exchange for Mithril Ingots (30:1)
Exchange for Epic Yellow Gems (80:1)
Exchange for Purple Knife Coins (250:1)
You, you…

[???] Thank you.
[Neko] Who are you, and why show up in a place like this?
Way too suspicious!
[???] Uh… do I look that suspicious?
And do you know how dangerous that just was? That big guy was Sky-Tier Rank 4!

[???] Is that so, Sky-Tier Rank 4…
(By my intel, that corresponds to Stellar-Tier Rank 4.)
With your strength, taking on that Wildbeast just now
carried no small risk, didn't it?
Even so, you didn't hesitate to help someone?
It was no trouble at all — none of your business, and are you looking down on me?
…Wait! You're not allowed to leave!

[???] Is there something else?
[Neko] You…
Since you're so capable, take me out of the forest.
I can't find the way back.
[???] Heh, all right. Little girl, what's your name?
[Neko] …

Neko, that's my name. And you?
[Feng] I'm called 【Feng】.
…………… Along the way, the two gradually fell into easy conversation.

[Neko] (How to put it… this guy, though he seemed to act strangely when I first saw him.)
(But walking along together, he's unexpectedly easy to get along with.)
Feng… you should be older than me, so I'll just call you Brother Feng.
If you don't mind, call me Koko.
[Feng] Sure. Koko, you said just now — this is the center of the Yangang Fief's sphere of influence?
And where we're headed is the Yangang Fief's 【capital city】, Yangang City?
Yes, only the Beast Tide has struck,

[Neko] the Yangang Fief's powerhouses are all fending off the Beast Tide,
so the city's a bit empty for now.
[Feng] Then… once we're out of the forest,
I'll trouble you to lead the way.

【Feng】 joined the party!
Something's up!

(Baifang shows up with a band of Hundred-Clans people!)
[Baifang] Haha, and who do we have here — why, it's Miss Neko.
(Reversal: our side's Leidong appears)
(A tense standoff)
(Reversal: the enemy's Baiyanta appears)
(Another round of tense standoff)
(Reversal: the enemy is scared off by Brother Feng)
A sudden new turn!

(The Hundred-Clans people got robbed by the 13 Axes!)
(Lacking Restraint Potions, the Hundred-Clans people can't beat the 13 Axes!)
(Baiyanta flees to Neko crying for help!)
(The 13 Axes think the good stuff is on Neko and get ready to rob her!)

Credit where it's due, there really was a 1.21Δ worth of good stuff…
(The 1.21Δ item suddenly went off and killed the whole 13 Axes!)
(Uncle Lei suddenly, excitedly urges Neko and Feng to get close!)

[Feng] Heh, it's nothing. We're safe for now, so let's move on. Whatever there is to say, save it for the capital.
[Neko] Ugh, what IS with this guy — so strong, why didn't he say so sooner!
All that effort I spent saving him earlier — actually, even a Savage-Gu Beast stacked with a billion layers of aura couldn't scratch him!
Whew—— finally out of that pitch-black forest.

[Leidong] Lord Feng, I know this city very well; if there's anywhere you'd like to go…
[Feng] No need… let's part ways here.
[Neko] Part… ways?
(A flicker of loss crossed Neko's eyes)
[Feng] By the way, where's the best lodging in Yangang City?
[Neko] Feiyun Pavilion.
[Feng] Mm, if you want to find me, go to Feiyun Pavilion.

【Feng】 left the party!
Brother Feng, you… have something you want to ask?
Little one, that Technique you're using now — where did you get it?
…Two years ago, I found it aboard the "alien visitor's" spaceship.

[Feng] This Technique contains only the basics, and still has many imperfections.
Let me give you a deeper Technique to study.

Feng flicked his fingers, and two beams of light shot out and bored into Neko's brow.
Neko felt a swelling ache in her head,
and then a flood of knowledge suddenly welled up.

Starmirror Flower · Myriad Stars, Starmirror Flower · Superstar, Starmirror Flower · Flower Sea
have been added to your selectable Techniques!
…This time, in fending off the Beast Tide,

[Neko] the rewards the Lord's Manor gives the top rankers
probably can't compare to what Brother Feng gave me.
[Feng] The Beast Tide?
Come to think of it, there's something odd about it.
It seems to have been caused by the spaceship crash,
but from what I understand, inside that 【D9 Spaceship】
is an enormous reactor,
and this continent lacks the knowledge to run it safely.

Each time this kind of primal-energy reactor explodes,
it leaks a great deal of 【primal-energy radiation】.
Judging by the traces at the site,
to refine a batch of 【Superior Evolution Crystals】,
this reactor exploded a full 58 times.
Huh—— but so many people died, why…

So long as the sacrifice of thousands upon thousands of the weak
buys one powerhouse's breakthrough,
its value to the race far outweighs those thousands.
Besides, mutated Wildbeast materials are worth more,
and make suitable training targets too.
Can't accept it? That's fine.
After all, I've never blown up a core reactor.
In the end, this is only my conjecture.
Suddenly… I've lost all interest in fending off the Beast Tide.

These are things a 【powerhouse】 must come to recognize.
Rather than fending off the Beast Tide,
perhaps there's a place better suited to you.
About ten thousand li east of Yangang City,
there's a hidden place
where the flow of time seems to have been accelerated.
But Brother Feng, why don't you go yourself…

No need. Those things were left by a domain-lord…
a Domain-Tier powerhouse,
and packed up altogether they're not worth even 0.01Δ,
so they mean nothing to me.
Remember, be very careful.
I'll leave a spiritual mark on you;
when you meet danger, use it to communicate with me.
So cold… Sister. Why isn't this snowfield marked on the Yangang Fief map?

This should be the place that mysterious powerhouse Feng spoke of.
The environment truly is harsh — low temperature plus the ice element;
even an Earth-Tier probably risks freezing to death here.
I can't take it, it's too cold. Let's just spread a flame Domain to keep warm.

[Nanami] Don't use a Domain for that…
wait, Koko, have you ever turned your flame Domain off?
[Neko] Uh…
Anyway, Sister, come a little closer!

Nanami joined the party! Ability effectiveness increased by 5%!
Hm, what's this? (touch)

Neko's hand touched this ice-and-snow portal.
In an instant, a bone-chilling cold
traveled up from her palm, making the girl shiver.
Before Neko's eyes appeared a long corridor,
stretching straight ahead.
Both sides of the corridor were towering, transparent ice walls.

Instinctively she stepped toward the end of the corridor,
and soon saw an ice door.
This ice door looked plain and unadorned, giving off a pale-blue glow.
The power of ice-cold, as if tangible, filled the air,
gradually converging into a scene both strange and familiar——
a vast, water-blue six-pointed star array!
A Domain… an ice-element Domain!

Neko's hand rose beyond her control, flame energy sweeping out,
spreading around her,
and in an instant colliding with the huge ice-blue six-pointed star!
A violent explosion rang out all around,
and the whole corridor shook violently.
The shockwave swept the area,
cracks appeared in the ice walls, then swiftly healed.
The water-blue six-pointed star likewise developed gaps,
and the searing flame energy seized the opening,
fusing into the star's cracks, until at last it vanished.
Water, nourishing all things… fire, illuminating everything…

[Nanami] Koko, wake up…
don't scare your sister.
Neko opened her dazed eyes,
her sister's anxious voice reaching her.
[Nanami] Koko! You suddenly fainted just now, I thought you…
Do you remember what happened?
(constructing a micro-array) How did you know my Domain broke through?

[Nanami] Huh? When did… I see, so it was that Frost Portal just now.
That's my Koko — always giving your sister a fright.
Speaking of which, I found this inside just now…

Obtained [Age-Old Frostmarrow Ingot]!
Something's off, Sister.

[Neko] In the earlier battles, after those fellows died,
their "kin," far from being afraid,
charged in even more frantically.
It's just not like normal people…
If I had to compare, it's more like those emotionless 【technological creations】 we met before.

[Nanami] Huh, no way?
You mean these fellows aren't real humans?
[Neko] Among real humans, how could they charge in by the thousands like this?

[???] Congratulations, congratulations. Outsiders,
you've cracked this place's secret!
As a reward, I'll send you somewhere fun — the 【Water Prison】.
[Nanami] You're… that girl we saw before!
So it really was you who deliberately led us here.
[Neko] (eyes lighting up) It sounds like an incredible place!
Sister, Sister, wake up…

[Nanami] Mm, Koko…?! Thank goodness, you're still here…
[Neko] I'm fine… that girl didn't kill us, she just tossed us here…
[Xiyue] Welcome, you two cute little girls.
Kukuku, I'm still here. Rather than "that girl," you'd best call me 【Xiyue】.
Is it you who's been leading us? Why do this?

[Xiyue] This is all the master's arrangement.
Though I never expected this batch of outsiders to be so cute, kukuku.
You two — this Water Prison holds several hundred Sky-Tier powerhouses,
ranging in strength from Sky-Tier Rank 1-2 to Rank 5-6.
To get out, the method is simple——
kill every powerhouse in this Water Prison!
The exit will open to the final victor.

[Neko] Only a few hundred? Breaking through to Sky-Tier Rank 6 alone needs 1.12e15 XP. That's nowhere near enough!

[Xiyue] Kukuku, there's also a barrier the master set here. Nurtured by abundant water element, this place produces water 【Spirits】 up to Sky-Tier Rank 7. In short, combat XP is absolutely guaranteed! You're free to run wherever you like here, but Sky-Tier Rank 7 enemies aren't found just anywhere! All right, my task is done. Good luck, bye-bye~
Hey, hey!

[Nanami] Looks like she really left.
[Neko] What do we do now, Sister… there's not a single 【Spirit】 here.
[Nanami] Not necessarily. Maybe we can go seek out the powerhouses in the Water Prison and try to talk with them.
[Neko] Huh, we're going to find them?
[Nanami] They may be troubled by the 【Spirits'】 attacks too. Helping them deal with the 【Spirits】 seems like a win-win.

[Zhuhu] Oho, a fresh face?
Heh, the Water Prison hasn't had a newcomer in a while.

[Nanami] Hello. Are you a powerhouse imprisoned here too?

[Zhuhu] That's right, been locked up here for a few hundred years now. Oh, that little girl over there — that weapon in your hand, not bad.
Are you calling me…?
[Zhuhu] That's right. Tsk tsk, looks like a high-quality psychokinetic weapon. Well then, I'll help myself to it without ceremony.
This, this I can't just give you!

[Zhuhu] Hahaha, how naive. Newcomers, you don't understand the rules here yet, do you? Here the strong reign, and killing is an everyday affair. Two early Sky-Tier… hah?! Is it too late to beg for mercy now?
[Nanami] In that case, no more talk—— you can just die here. (Koko, taking down this guy is up to you!)
So now, just who's the one dying here?

[Zhuhu] Naive! No matter how well you fight, limited by your realm……………

(dead silence)

[Neko] Since I'm in a good mood today, you can go~

[Zhuhu] Then I'll take my leave, my ladies——
Kill

[Zhuhu] Mercy——

(sound of the Moonwheel slicing)

[Neko] There, that's about enough — let's bury him like this.
[Nanami] You've grown up…

Obtained Swamp · Wildbeast Meat * 5!
Obtained Crystallized Sword (Quality 239%)!
Obtained 259B 346D 107Z 197X 56C!
Honestly, outmatched in skill and still talking big.

[Nanami] (the Water Prison's strength assessment is omitted here) Remember what you said before, aboard that alien visitor's spaceship?
[Neko] Which words do you mean?
[Nanami] You said that once you became Sky-Tier Rank 9 inside the spaceship, the trouble would resolve itself!

As if struck by sudden enlightenment, Neko seemed to realize something, and her eyes lit up at once.
But Sister, level-suppression docks 80% of XP.

[Nanami] Only when your strength exceeds everyone else's do you suffer such a penalty. And once you've surpassed everyone, doesn't the crisis simply cease to exist?

[Neko] That makes sense.
You sought us out — what for?
Don't worry, I've no intention of coming after you. I just want to learn how marvelous the 【Domain】 that could suppress Zhuhu really is.
Not interested, and it's weird.

[Neko] Locked in a cage, your very survival uncertain, and still you think of sparring with people…

[Moore] I know the dangers here better than you do, of course. But next to growing stronger, what does that count for? I can tell you — a few of the strongest in this Water Prison have very odd tempers. Like the ranking's publisher 【Lanqi】, the Falling-Leaf Blade 【Qiuxing】, and others — each is dozens of times stronger than me.

[Nanami] So, do you think we'll agree? Fighting here does us no good at all, and might even draw other powerhouses.

[Moore] Mm, true. I figured you two wouldn't agree easily. But—— this isn't a rash offense; it's a deal.
Huh? What deal, what are you talking about?

[Moore] Cute little one, the weapon in your hand is strong. I've studied psychokinetic weapons for a long time; the architecture of your Moonwheel is at least Peak spirit-treasure grade. Even Skyhigh-Tier powerhouses would flock to it. But for now you can't bring out its might. And I, perhaps, can help you.
[Neko] You mean——!

[Moore] If I win, I'll do nothing. I only ask to learn your insight, or hear your views on the way of the Domain.

[Moore] I know what you're worried about. I swear on the honor of a ranked powerhouse — I'll never pull any tricks. Besides, do something shameful, and once word gets out from here, it'd mean ruin and disaster.

[Neko] All right… I accept. In that case, go ahead.

As agreed, Moore taught Neko his insights on psychokinetic weapons without reservation. Only now did she realize that in this Water Prison it isn't all kill-or-be-killed — there are quite a few powerhouses, like Moore, wholly devoted to cultivation. In their talk, she could feel Moore's yearning to grow stronger, a yearning whose worth even surpassed survival. Soon, the Moonwheel built of 216 white crystals bloomed with a more resplendent radiance in the girl's hand…
【Silver Frost Moonwheel】 gained 2.99e20 XP!
(Falling-Leaf Blade…! The third-ranked Falling-Leaf Blade!)
[Qiuxing] Aha, I know what you want to say. Actually, I found your hiding spot long ago. I was just waiting for you to grow — until you were strong enough to stand against me.
If you want a stronger opponent, why fixate on us?
[Qiuxing] Hahaha, little girl, when you see a fun toy, could you bear to leave it unplayed with?
